general.title: General emergency tips
tips: Call emergency services if anyone is hurt or in immediate danger.
Move to a safer location if you can do so without taking new risks.
Keep phone charged and share your location with a trusted contact.
Follow official alerts from local emergency management.

wildfire.title: Wildfire guidance
tips: If told to evacuate, leave early and take a go-bag.
Avoid smoke: close windows and use an N95 if available.
Do not drive through heavy smoke or active fire areas.
Check air quality before returning outdoors.

earthquake.title: Earthquake guidance
tips: Drop, cover, and hold on until shaking stops.
Stay clear of windows, shelves, and falling objects.
Aftershock risk remains: check for injuries and hazards before moving.
If outdoors, move away from buildings and power lines.

flood.title: Flood guidance
tips: Turn around, don't drown: avoid walking or driving through floodwater.
Move to higher ground if water is rising nearby.
Stay off bridges over fast-moving water.
Assume floodwater may be contaminated.

landslide.title: Landslide / mudslide guidance
tips: Leave the area if you hear rumbling or see ground cracking.
Avoid hillside roads during heavy rain when possible.
Watch for tilted trees, poles, or sudden water flow changes.
Do not dig into or climb unstable slopes.

chemical.title: Chemical hazard guidance
tips: Move upwind and away from the release if it is safe to do so.
Shelter indoors: close windows, vents, and HVAC if advised.
Avoid contact with spilled material and contaminated clothing.
Seek medical help for breathing trouble, burning eyes, or dizziness.

industrial.title: Industrial incident guidance
tips: Leave the immediate area and keep others back.
Cover nose and mouth if smoke or fumes are present.
Follow local shelter-in-place or evacuate orders.
Report strong chemical smells or visible plumes to authorities.

radiation.title: Radiation hazard guidance
tips: Get inside, stay inside, and stay tuned to official instructions.
Close windows and turn off outdoor air intake if possible.
Do not self-evacuate through a known plume path unless told to.
Wait for official guidance on potassium iodide or decontamination.

tsunami.title: Tsunami guidance
tips: If you feel a strong coastal quake or get a warning, move inland/uphill immediately.
Do not wait to see the wave.
Stay away from the beach and harbor until officials reopen the area.
A tsunami may arrive as multiple waves over hours.

heat.title: Extreme heat guidance
tips: Drink water regularly and limit outdoor activity in peak heat.
Use AC or cooling centers if available.
Watch for heat exhaustion: heavy sweating, weakness, nausea.
Never leave people or pets in a parked car.

drought.title: Drought-related guidance
tips: Conserve water and follow local water restrictions.
Watch for dry vegetation and higher wildfire risk.
Stay hydrated in hot, dry conditions.
Check air quality during dust events.

sinkhole.title: Sinkhole guidance
tips: Keep clear of cracked pavement, fences, or sudden ground dips.
Do not approach or enter a sinkhole.
Report utility smells or outages near the site.
Evacuate nearby structures if officials advise.
